# sherpa-gauge-chart

A half-circle gauge for a single value on a 0–100 scale. Each band is a closed SVG path, as [sherpa-radial-chart](sherpa-radial-chart.md) draws a slice, so the band itself is the hover target and the hollow centre is not hittable.

## When to use it

For one value on a scale (0–100 by default), read by a needle, with optional threshold bands in `data-zones`. For a headline number with its trend, use `sherpa-metric`; for a task as it runs, use `sherpa-progress-bar`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-gauge-chart data-label="Mean risk" data-unit="%" data-caption="of 100"></sherpa-gauge-chart>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-gauge-chart`:

```json
42
```

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | heading above the gauge |
| `caption` | content | rich caption below the gauge; overrides data-caption |
| `legend` | legend | a &lt;[sherpa-chart-legend](sherpa-chart-legend.md)> naming the zones; the gauge fills it from zones that are named. |

## populate()

`number \| { value, zones? }`

set the value. `zones` are its field's thresholds, drawn where `data-zones` says none.
